name: Session Flow
tagline: Five UX features for the Hermes Desktop session sidebar in one plain-ESM plugin
summary: Ctrl+Scroll session cycling, Firefox-style session groups with project grouping, a session pane with list/grid views, sidebar-style content tabs, and personalization — five features in one plugin, all live-configurable from a built-in settings page.
description:
Session Flow turns Hermes Desktop's session sidebar into something that *feels* like a real app:

1. **Ctrl+Scroll = session cycling** — hold a modifier and wheel through your active sessions; a HUD shows position and title. Zoom surfaces keep their own behaviour.
2. **Session pane with Firefox-style groups** — list or grid, groups collapse into a stack (spine/fanned/pill), optional auto-grouping by date/source/project folder. Drop a tab on a project header to move it. Live status icons (thinking / writing / tool / waiting / done / error). Search + quick filter bar. App quick-start row above the toolbar.
3. **Sidebar-style UI tabs** — content-area tabs become rounded chips like the sidebar session rows. Live session info from the sidebar: working sessions get the travelling glow ring on their tab.
4. **Personalization** — pick your own accent color and choose the pane surface (native sidebar / chat / none).

All live-configurable from a built-in settings page (EN + DE). The standalone full build in this repo adds chat line animation, composer glass and a chat background via documented Desktop-Bridge doors — it is not part of the catalog entry and is disclosed in the repo README.

catalog.note: SDK-only build — the entry the Hermes Plugin Catalog lists and loads at the pinned SHA (catalog rule 8).

full.note: Standalone build with all UI decorations (composer chip, glass, UI tabs, chat animation, chat background) — distributed via install.sh, not part of the catalog entry.

notes: Two builds from one source: desktop/plugin.js (SDK-only catalog build, rule-8 clean — the entry the catalog loads) and full/plugin.js (standalone, all UI decorations, via install.sh). All 30 marketing images are reproducible from the HTML sources under docs/marketing/src/. Contact: info@agantila.com.
